newsitem.title: USA: Xircom to divest its Netaccess unit.
newsitem.headline: Xircom to divest its Netaccess unit.

text.p: Xircom Inc said Monday it plans to divest Netaccess Inc, its remote-access subsidiary.
The company said in a statement that, until the divestiture of Netaccess is complete, it will account for the unit as discontinued operations in its earnings statements.

Net sales for Netaccess were $4.1 million for the fiscal second quarter, 24 percent below the comparable year-ago quarter. For the six months of fiscal 1997, net sales for Netaccess were $10.1 million compared with $9.2 million last year.
